user.title: Water heater switch
user.description: Pick the switch or smart plug that powers a storage water heater and reports its power.

data_description.switch_entity: The on/off switch that powers the heater. It will be controlled through the new water heater entity.
data_description.power_entity: The power reading in W of that switch. It is the model's only measurement.

name.title: Name the water heater
name.description: The integration creates a device with this name, in the switch's area. Entity IDs are built from the area and this name.

data_description.name: Leave out hardware words like Switch or Plug, so the IDs describe the device's function, e.g. master_bath_water_heater.

heater.title: The heater
heater.description: There are no defaults: take the values from your heater, its recorded history, or a measurement. The README lists a reference heater.

data_description.thermostat: Water temperature when the tank is full. Measure the hot tap right after a reheat finishes.
data_description.thermostat_band: Energy of one normal small reheat, when the heater tops up a full tank after standing idle.
data_description.heat_loss: Standby heat loss per degree between tank and room. A constant of the heater and its pipes.

data_description.cold_water_temperature: Temperature of the cold mains water.
data_description.warm_water_temperature: All water is counted as litres at this temperature, e.g. your usual shower temperature.
data_description.from_history: Replay the switch's recorded history to start with the current tank state, and write statistics for that period so charts start before today.

showers.title: Showers (optional)
showers.description: Fill in both to split water into showers and other use, or leave both empty to count water as one total.

data_description.shower_flow: Litres per minute at the shower head. With two heads, use their average.
data_description.shortest_shower: Water use at least this long (at the shower flow) counts as a shower; shorter use is Other Water.

error.showers_incomplete: Fill in both shower fields, or leave both empty.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.

init.title: Power Metered Water Heater settings
init.description: Changes apply from now on; past statistics are kept as they are. Leave both shower fields empty to turn showers off.
